name: flat-buyin-then-rounds
description: 2007 Hopper: a 1000m row buy-in, THEN 5 rounds. The AI expresses this shape with NO sections[] — openai.ts flattens buyIn[] into movements[] carrying role:'buy_in', perRound:false and a 'Buy-In: ' name prefix. The poster used to render all three movements as peers under one '5 ROUNDS' format line, printing the prefix as part of the name ('1000m Buy-In: Row') so the once-only row read as if it repeated five times. Must render BUY-IN / THEN 5 ROUNDS OF headers with the prefix stripped. Also pins lb loads surviving to the poster.

workout.title: Workout 1
workout.rawText:
